# 1st Choice Dental Care

> > Full-service dental practice in Kennesaw and Woodstock, GA offering general, cosmetic, implant, and specialty dental care with same-day restoration solutions.

1st Choice Dental Care serves the greater Atlanta area with comprehensive dental services including preventative care, cosmetic dentistry, dental implants, and innovative full-mouth restoration solutions like Restore in 24. The practice operates two convenient locations and emphasizes patient-centered care with flexible financing and sedation options.

## Key Topics

- Restore in 24
- All-on-4/All-on-6 implants
- Dental implants
- Full-mouth restoration
- Cosmetic dentistry
- Invisalign
- Preventative care
- Same-day teeth
- Tooth replacement
- Financing options
- CBCT imaging
- Sedation dentistry
- Kennesaw location
- Woodstock location
- NexHealth scheduling

## Dental Services

- [General Dentistry](https://www.my1stchoicedentalcare.com/general-dentistry): General dentistry services including cleanings, exams, restorative and preventative care.
- [Cosmetic Services](https://www.my1stchoicedentalcare.com/cosmetic-dentistry): Cosmetic dentistry services: teeth whitening, veneers, crowns, bridges, smile makeovers.
- [Preventive Care](https://www.my1stchoicedentalcare.com/preventative-care): Preventative care: exams, cleanings, cavity prevention, fluoride treatments.
- [Orthodontics](https://www.my1stchoicedentalcare.com/orthodontics): Invisalign clear aligners and orthodontic treatment for teeth alignment.
- [Stayput Dentures](https://www.my1stchoicedentalcare.com/stayput-dentures): StayPut implant-removable dentures for comfortable tooth replacement solutions.
- [Emergency Services](https://www.my1stchoicedentalcare.com/emergency-services): Emergency dental services for traumatic injuries, chipped teeth, same-day appointments.
